label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparations for tomorrow's civic thanks presentation in the great hall at 18:00, with refreshments and setup details withheld from me. Innkeeper organized the appointment and insists I arrive only when setup finishes; builder paid baker in materials for forty-four loaves, whose private destination baker declined to disclose. Those loaves likely relate to the gathering, though that link is unconfirmed. Secretary knowingly helps schedule the presentation; freight carried bread into the hall, but whether freight knows the larger plan is uncertain.
